production.note: US model years 2023 onward. Start: Ford Authority (Brett Foote, 15 August 2022) on 'The V8-powered 2023 Ford Raptor R'. Ford's 2024 tech specs list the Raptor R (ford-raptor-2024-tech-specs); The Autopian (Mercedes Streeter, 13 May 2026) tested a 2025 Raptor R and says it is similar to the 2026 truck (autopian-raptor-r-2025), so it is treated as still on sale. No Ford page giving the model-year range was opened.

body.note: Ford: 'Body configuration SuperCrew®'; the sheet lists only the SuperCrew cab.

displacementL.note: Ford: 'Displacement ... 5.2 liters (315 cubic inches)'. 315 cu in is about 5,162 cc; no cc figure is printed on the sheet.

drivetrain.note: Ford: 'Hi-lock transfer case; two-speed automatic four-wheel-drive system with neutral towing capability' and '2-speed torque on-demand'. A two-speed transfer case, so 4WD under the data guide's rule.

powerHp.note: Ford 2024 F-150 Raptor tech specs, Raptor R column. Quote: "SAE horsepower* 450 hp @ 5,850 rpm 720 hp @ 6,650 rpm" (450 hp is the Raptor, 720 hp the Raptor R); torque 640 lb-ft @ 4,300 rpm. The 2023 Raptor R was rated 700 hp (Roadblazing's 2023 review: "Horsepower petrol / Torque (pound - feet): 700 hp* / 640 lb-ft @ 4250 r.p.m.", roadblazing-raptor-r-2023), so the reference year is 2024, the first year of the 720-hp rating, which has applied for most of the run. The Autopian's 2025 truck: "Output: 720 horsepower at 6,650 RPM, 640 lb.-ft. of torque at 4,250 RPM."

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md). Car and Driver's road test 'Tested: 2024 Ford F-150 Raptor R Piles More on Top', read by the project owner (figure given 8 October, page link 9 October 2026) (the site blocks the research tools): "2024 Ford F-150 Raptor R: 6090 lbs Curb weight". It is the road-test curb weight of the test truck. Corroborated by The Autopian (Mercedes Streeter, 2025 truck, autopian-raptor-r-2025), unlabelled: "this hulking 6,090-pound colossus". SuperCrew 4WD, 10-speed automatic. Ford's approximate 5,950 lb and Roadblazing's 6,077 lb are for the 700-hp 2023 truck; see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Model year and measurement. Ford Authority reports Ford's pre-launch approximate figure for the 2023 truck: "The V8-powered 2023 Ford Raptor R will tip the scales at approximately 5,950 pounds". Roadblazing's 2023 review: "Curb Weight (pounds): 6077 lbs." Both are for the 700-hp 2023 model year; Car and Driver's 6,090 lb is a tested weight of a 2024 truck.
discrepancies.resolution: The reference year is 2024 (720 hp), so the 2024 figure is used; the 2023 figures are a different model year. Ford's 5,950 lb is also labelled approximate.
